SELECT t1.points, t1.device_code AS "deviceCode", t1.channel_code AS "channelCode", t2.model_code AS "modelCode", t2.device_model_code AS "deviceModelCode", t3.pic_sensor_length AS "picSensorLength", t3.pic_sensor_width AS "picSensorWidth", t3.min_focus AS "minFocus" FROM vm_algorithm_config t1 LEFT JOIN vm_device_info_t t2 ON t1.device_code = t2.device_code LEFT JOIN vm_device_model_t t3 ON t2.model_code = t3.mfgr_code AND t2.device_model_code = t3.device_model_code WHERE config_id = #{configId} AND t1.delete_flag = '0' AND t2.delete_flag = '0'

SELECT t1.config_id AS "configId", t1.points, t1.device_code AS "deviceCode", t1.channel_code AS "channelCode", t2.model_code AS "modelCode", t2.device_model_code AS "deviceModelCode", t3.pic_sensor_length AS "picSensorLength", t3.pic_sensor_width AS "picSensorWidth", t3.min_focus AS "minFocus" FROM vm_algorithm_config t1 LEFT JOIN vm_device_info_t t2 ON t1.device_code = t2.device_code LEFT JOIN vm_device_model_t t3 ON t2.model_code = t3.mfgr_code AND t2.device_model_code = t3.device_model_code WHERE t1.delete_flag = '0' AND t2.delete_flag = '0' AND pos_type = 2

SELECT count(*) FROM vm_video_preset WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND delete_flag = 0 AND industry_code = #{industryCode} AND preset_name = #{presetName} AND device_code = #{deviceCode} AND channel_code = #{channelCode} and preset_id != #{presetId}

select distinct t1.preset_id, t1.preset_name, t1.pan, t1.tilt, t1.zoom, t1.device_code, t1.channel_code, t1.tenant_id, t1.order_code, t1.industry_code, t1.snapshot_cycle, t1.snapshot_day, t1.snapshot_time, t1.double_img_analysis from vm_video_preset t1 left join vm_order_devices t2 on t1.device_code = t2.device_code and t1.tenant_id = t2.tenant_id and t1.industry_code = t2.industry_code where t1.delete_flag = 0 and t2.ord_status in (0,1,2) and t1.snapshot_cycle != 0 and t1.snapshot_time like CONCAT('%',#{time},'%') and ((t1.snapshot_cycle = 1) or (t1.snapshot_cycle = 2 and t1.snapshot_day like CONCAT('%',#{weekday},'%')) or (t1.snapshot_cycle = 3 and t1.snapshot_day like CONCAT('%',#{day},'%')))

SELECT DISTINCT us.USER_ID,us.USER_NAME,us.tenant_id,d.INDUSTRY_CODE,us.USER_TYPE FROM sys_user us LEFT JOIN ( WITH RECURSIVE cte AS ( SELECT 1 AS n UNION ALL SELECT n + 1 FROM cte WHERE n < 50 ) SELECT us_inner.USER_ID, SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(us_inner.DEPT_ID, ',', n), ',', -1) AS split_dept_id FROM sys_user us_inner JOIN cte ON cte.n <= ( LENGTH(us_inner.DEPT_ID) - LENGTH(REPLACE(us_inner.DEPT_ID, ',', '')) + 1 ) WHERE us_inner.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND us_inner.USER_ID = #{userId} ) us_split ON us.USER_ID = us_split.USER_ID LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.DEPT_ID = us_split.split_dept_id AND d.del_flag = '0' WHERE us.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND us.USER_ID = #{userId}
